prompts.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Production game sprite atlas, not concept art. Input 1 is the exact character identity; input 2 is the animation pose reference. Original user-created dark fantasy pixel-painted skeletal flame death knight: exposed skull with red eyes and blazing orange flame crown, dark charcoal spiked plate armor, ragged black cape, one orange-red rune sword. Preserve identity, proportions, material and colors. Create exactly 12 separate full-body poses in a perfectly regular FOUR columns by THREE rows grid, landscape 4:3 image, with generous transparent gaps in every cell. TRUE TRANSPARENT alpha background, no checkerboard, ground, text, labels, borders, grid lines or shadows. Every pose complete head-to-toe with entire sword and flame arcs inside its own cell. All poses same anatomical size and baseline. Row1 four walking frames heel strike / passing / opposite heel strike / passing; alternate legs distinctly, sword visible held low in EVERY frame, cape sways gently, flame crown stable size. Row2 four clearly different sword ATTACK frames: 1 sword drawn back above shoulder and torso winds up, 2 forward weight transfer and downward slash halfway, 3 completed slash with flame crescent in front, 4 recover sword to low ready. The arm and sword must actually swing, not four static poses with effects. Row3: column1 casting gather with free hand raised and sword lowered, column2 flame release with free palm extended, column3 hit recoil torso leaning back, column4 recovering to ready. Keep feet planted for attack/cast/hit. Keep flame arcs compact enough to fit cell. No disappearance of weapon, extra limbs or weapons. ALL twelve poses face front, front three-quarter facing down-right toward the viewer. Face and chest visible in ALL frames. Aim the sword swing toward foreground/down-right. Use reference animation poses but repair missing swords in walk frames and reduce wild size changes.
